analysis_summary.title: Split App.jsx and the pixel catalog
analysis_summary.root_cause: TRACKING_PLATFORMS data is co-located with detection logic in src/lib/pixel-detector.js, forcing 7 dashboard files and 1 test to import a library module for a pure data structure. App.jsx (643 lines) is far above the 400-line target.

analysis_summary.title: Rename detectFacebookPixel*
analysis_summary.root_cause: Three exported functions in pixel-detector.js carry 'Facebook' in their name but detect 50+ ad networks — names are a historic artifact from when the project was Facebook-only.

analysis_summary.title: Fix SmartyAds Criteo domain
analysis_summary.root_cause: TRACKING_PLATFORMS.smartyads.domains contains 'as.us.criteo.com', a Criteo CDN host. The literal-key DOMAIN_TO_PLATFORM_MAP returns 'smartyads' for any URL containing that string, misattributing Criteo traffic.

analysis_summary.title: Point CI test job at coverage output
analysis_summary.root_cause: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs `npm run test:run` (no coverage provider) but the next step uploads path: coverage/, which is never created. Result: an empty 'test-results' artifact on every CI run.

analysis_summary.title: Un-skip or replace the iframe pixel test
analysis_summary.root_cause: tests/unit/pixel-detector.test.js:115 has it.skip on the iframe-pixel test due to a jsdom limitation, with a TODO comment promising future work that never landed. The skip leaves a coverage hole.
